prompt_en: A macro photograph of a pine cone centers on the gaps between its scales and their rough woody surfaces. The scales are dry, with fibrous ridges and slightly chipped edges interrupting their repeated pattern. Low side light grazes across the scale relief, bringing raised ridges into brightness while the crevices hold narrow shadows. A close crop lets the overlapping scales form an irregular layered rhythm. The central cluster is crisply resolved; neighboring layers soften gently enough to retain their shapes. The cone rests against a plain charcoal-brown background. Muted russet and umber tones keep attention on the transition from illuminated surface to shaded gap.

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: Preserve all independently frozen requester-owned scale, dry-state, macro and low-side-light evidence.
semantic_clarification_decisions.prompt_evidence: gaps between its scales and their rough woody surfaces

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: The proposed broken world invariant adds surreal treatment to an ordinary dry material study whose resolved surreal setting is zero.
This optional neon palette is not preferred for the restrained earthy study; competing colored sources add no needed explanation of the dry relief.
The existing adult-context gate is inactive, and people and interpersonal behavior are outside this object-only request.
Printed collage fragments on a board are a different material structure from the pine cone scales and are not adopted.
Compatible volume modeling is already independently authored. The registry-specific artifact relation adds no necessary improvement, so preserve the baseline without selecting this profile.
Low describes illumination elevation here. A dark wall and luminance-noise treatment are unnecessary additions to the requested woody surface relief.
Transmitting garment layers require cloth and garment structure rather than the specified pine cone material.
Human upper-lip and philtral anatomy is incompatible with this nonhuman cone subject and the explicit no-people instruction.
A submerged contour and water attenuation conflict with the dry pine cone state and its surface-led macro purpose.
Wearable protective geometry and articulated body joints describe a different object system from natural pine cone scales.
A short pleated skirt is a garment rather than the requested woody scale structure, despite superficial repeated ridges.

decisions.rationale: The complete relation requires body and leg visibility plus an atmosphere change, neither needed nor open for this dry object-only macro scene.
Its declared body_geometry dimension is closed; a vast external shadow does not improve the requested small crevice relief.
This optional style could coexist with the subject, but grain and print-scan layering would compete with the precise woody texture and are not preferred.
Adding a water plane and reflected object introduces a separate relationship that weakens the requested microrelief focus; retain the simpler baseline.
Manufactured casing plates and edge fasteners are not pine cone scales. Their appearance changes are outside open scope and the complete artifact meaning is declined.

review.summary: I reviewed the complete final prompt. It contains a stationary pine cone and photographic light, focus and background only; no person, animal, articulated bodily mechanism or bodily interaction appears.
